author: Mark Atwood
text: Interop alert (edge-codereview of b7z9.121.3): the Python slice already landed yggdrasil_address(pubkey) verification (commit 026bcedd). Until this C slice lands, C receivers still synthesize 0200:0000::IID transcripts, so Python<->C SOS origin verification is broken both directions. Fix is scoped here; b7z9.121.5 covers the vector regeneration. Treat migration as live breakage, not a future cleanup.
